7614.title: Provider maintenance omits request-scoped executable configuration
7614.rootCauseOneLine: Installation and health omit contributed environment across the host contract and Claude maintenance reads only process environment.
7614.proposedFix: Resolve host-scoped provider environment on the server and transport it through maintenance requests, with environment-aware caching and protocol-version handling.
7614.caveats: Unavailable process override models the missing global CLI because this Linux host has a fallback CLI. Original macOS/plugin/composer and cache timing are unverified; no automatic PR because the fix changes the host protocol and multiple subsystems.
